locale_notes: The generic repo Spanish locale maps to Spain for the canonical 21-locale set. For Latin American distribution also generate/adapt es-MX on Apple and es-419 (and optionally es-US) on Google; do not assume es-ES serves every Spanish storefront.

Other optional regional variants: Apple English en-AU/en-CA/en-GB and French fr-CA; Google corresponding English/French and Traditional Chinese zh-HK. These are regional expansions, not additional supported app languages.
Never derive store identifiers by blindly appending regions. In particular Google Hebrew is iw-IL, Indonesian is id, Ukrainian is uk, Thai is th, Vietnamese is vi.
Inventory existing store locales before upload and preserve unrelated existing locales. Canonical mappings do not authorize deleting regional variants.

Locale text localization does not translate screenshots, screenshot captions, preview audio, privacy documents, or websites. Existing default assets can be inherited; distinguish that from localized assets.

keywords.notes: Official platform-version reference explicitly says bytes. Use conservative UTF-8 validation.

global_or_separate: Apple version/build/copyright, category, release settings and App Review notes/contact/test login are not per-locale marketing fields.
Google developer contact email/phone/website and default language are edits.details/global fields; privacy URL is separate console configuration.
In-app purchase/subscription localized display names and descriptions are separate resources and require an explicit inventory if all store language is intended to include them.
Keep valid shared URLs unchanged unless localized destinations actually exist. Brand NewsBlur stays unchanged.

api_upload.apple: Read appInfos and editable appStoreVersions. Upsert appInfoLocalizations and appStoreVersionLocalizations by exact locale with POST for missing/PATCH for existing. Fetch every resulting field again and compare. Metadata must be editable; submission/release is a separate operation.
api_upload.google: Create one edit; read existing listings and target track. Upsert edits.listings.update per locale, merging any existing video. Set releaseNotes=[{language,text},...] on target version release through edits.tracks. Preserve versionCodes/status/other release attributes. Validate edit, commit only within release authorization, then open a new read edit and compare. Listings are shared across tracks.

notes: Subscription name/description limits match the official product-page guide and empty live App Store Connect form counters. The Help In-App Purchase reference still lists the stricter 30/45 limits.

Subscription-group display name and custom app-name limits were verified from empty live App Store Connect form counters. The official subscription reference distinguishes customer-facing display names from internal reference names but does not state these numerical limits.
